text:
maria: Heads-up — planning to HOLD PR #3298 until the Sunday-night canary window clears. CI queue is long; want to avoid colliding with the DB migration window. @sam @elaine can you take quick reviews?

sam: Can do — will prioritize in ~30m. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: CI queue length: 18 jobs. ETA to zero: ~3.5h. Flake rate: 2.3%.

raj: FYI the DB migration is 02:00 UTC, please avoid merges 01:30–02:30 UTC.

maria: Good call. Let's aim to land before 23:30 UTC to be safe. If CI clears earlier we can shift earlier.

elaine: Rebased locally, fixed a tiny schema conflict, all unit tests passing. Pushing the branch now.

sam: Left two tiny comments on the PR (nits). nothing blocking.

maria: Thanks. If someone can run the quick smoke after merge, @oliver?

oliver: I can run smoke. Plan: after merge I'll run `./scripts/quick-smoke.sh` against canary and post results here.

sam: Merge command (for reference):
```bash
# use squash merge to keep history tidy
gh pr merge 3298 --squash --body "Merge PR 3298: routing fixes"
```

maria: Note: prefer manual unhold + merge only after CI green and before 23:15 UTC. If CI still backlogged past that, defer to Monday morning instead of risking migration window.

release-council: Heads-up — if merge after 23:45 UTC there's a higher chance of nightly deploy interference. Recommend cut before 23:30.

qa-bot: Quick smoke scheduled: oliver at 23:20 UTC (reminder set).

elaine: Approved.

sam: LGTM after addressing nits.

maria: Final: holding merge until CI passes and we are under the 23:15 UTC soft deadline. I'll post GO/NO-GO once CI is green. Thanks all. :v:

(End of thread)
